text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaay☆ Did I keep ya waiting?\n'Sup, 
'sup~."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Yup, yup, yup,
yup!\n——Aha. Lookin' good! 
Vibes are high."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Ta-da!\nAlright, here I go~..."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Whaaat?! Amazing!\nOoooh...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "――――Aha♪\nPretty good, right? Be amazed☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two weeks until the Holy Hoof Festival――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous & Bono
text_block_list.text: "Marveloooous☆★☆\nBooooono♪"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your hard work.\nHow is
the 
progress coming along?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, as you can see. ——Extremely 
smooth!\nRight on the schedule you made 
for us."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Hup, hup... Ah, like this!\nFufu. I'm 
finally starting to feel confident!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"……Everyone's mindset has shifted. The 
atmosphere too. At this rate, there 
shouldn't be any issues for the upcoming 
'performance showcase' day."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Yes, indeed.\nSo, all that's left is――"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... I can't catch a single 
one~~~!!!\nI'm like,
seriously at my limit 
here, hello~~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……That is only natural. What you are 
attempting, Jordan-san, is juggling with 
'five' clubs. The difficulty is on an 
entirely different level compared to 
three."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I get it... but it's weird, 
y'know?\nIt's only two more!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……I have a suggestion.
Why not stick with 
what you can currently do――and perform 
with three juggling clubs for the actual 
show?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Given your current success rate,
there is 
a possibility it won't be ready by the 
deadline.\nFurthermore, you have other 
acts to perform, Jordan-san."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"To avoid overexerting yourself, lowering 
the difficulty here would be best.\nI 
believe that is the optimal choice for 
both you and the team..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm... Nah. Dialing it back is a no-go. 
Yeah.\n——There's no point if it ain't 
hard."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm gonna keep at it a bit 
longer.\nJust watch over me a little
more, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"(……2 days, 16 hours,
and 13 minutes until 
the 'performance showcase'.\nAt this
rate, 
Jordan-san will be the only one...)"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……?\nThere's light coming from the 
library..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's Flash-san.\nAay. Hype... 
*haaah*~~~."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……Jordan-san?\nWhy are you here at this 
hour...?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Can't ya tell? I'm studyin'.
Seriously do 
NOT\nwanna do this, though. ...Man, 
reading words is such a drag, for real..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"But like, the circus folks recommended a 
book to me.\nSo, I wanted some hints, 
y'know...?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……I see.
However...\nIf you push yourself 
too hard, you will ruin your health, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Totally! Staring at letters really does 
that to ya!\nSo with that said,
study time 
is over! Next is――"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"When throwing, focus on the 
wrists...\n――Gah! Dammit...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……No. What I meant was that you have 
already been active for over 7 hours and 
12 minutes today, so you should rest 
now..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hear me out, Flash-san! I had it for a 
second there, right? I'm starting to get 
the hang of it!\nThe throw timing and
all! 
...Alright. Imma seriously crush it from 
here on!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……I thought I understood,
but...\nYou are 
truly serious about this, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's totally uncool.\nRunning 
away just 'cause it's hard, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"……Whether I can do it or not doesn't 
matter. I'm sick of it already.\nI'm done 
using 'being clumsy' as an excuse to give 
up."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm gonna do it.
Juggling.\nEven if I 
can't do it right now――until I can."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, five is way harder than three, 
which makes it way cooler!\nI bet the 
fans'll be seriously blown away too~."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"——Just you watch.\nI'm gonna hype the 
whole floor up."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"……Please tell me one thing.
How many more 
days would you need to 'reliably' succeed 
at five-club juggling?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"……I'm planning to make the deadline 
anyway, but?\nStill, hmm... If I had one 
week. I can definitely nail it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Understood.\nExcuse me."

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival E...
text_block_list.text:
"……You want to push the performance 
showcase back by one week?\n……Um, may I 
ask the reason why?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. With just that much more time, we 
will be able to deliver our target 
performance."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I remember now... Why, as a child, 
Fastnacht—the carnival—
filled me with such 
wonder.)

text_block_list.name: Young Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! Look, Papa! Mama!! A huge 
carriage! Everyone's pulling it together!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Because it went beyond my imagination. 
The whole town decorated, parades singing 
down the streets, my father and mother 
both smiling... In other words—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Our circus must achieve that very same 
thing. The place Jordan-san is aiming for 
without running away is our true finish 
line.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"As it stands, we have prepared enough to 
satisfy the requirements. However... to 
grasp a goal one step higher,
we request a 
bit more time."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please, we humbly ask for your approval.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, one week later—

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival E...
text_block_list.text:
"T-The results are in! The circus 
performance you all submitted has..."

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival E...
text_block_list.text: "Been officially approved!!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Maaaaarvelouuuus☆★☆ Yayyyyy♪"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival E...
text_block_list.text:
"A flawless roster size and a
breathtaking 
performance! Above all, the teachers said 
they'd gladly support you after seeing 
your sheer passion!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival E...
text_block_list.text:
"The academy even said they'd hire 
external contractors to set up the venue 
equipment! Now we can hold the event with 
total peace of mind and safety...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Heheh. Heheheh. Wooohoo☆ Come on, you 
too, Flash!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Woo—... Ahem. We've made it this far.
All 
that's left is to do our best in the real 
show."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally. Let's make this circus go crazy 
hype!
